pages.text: The $(bold)Repeater$() does three jobs: it $(italic)repeats$() (resets signal to 15 and sends it on), it $(italic)delays$() (one to four ticks, right-click to set), and it's a $(italic)diode$() — signal passes one way only.
pages.title: Repeater

pages.text: $(bold)Locking.$() Drive a repeater's side with another repeater or comparator and its little latch drops — it $(italic)holds$() its current output, ignoring its input. A one-block memory cell.
pages.title: Locking
